production.canonicalMetadataSource: Authenticated project and D1 captures in the successful trusted-main workflow; not an independent connector resource GET.

limits: CSS syntax equivalence applies to mechanical formatting only; the two superseded declarations and emptied rule are recorded separately. Same-selector/same-value !important declarations remain in the later required unchanged stylesheet.
Visual controls use actual Keeper with disposable catalog/auth/version responses and generated EPUBs. No upload action or live catalog/provider writes occur in those cases.

Same-DOM comparison preserves stylesheet positions and checks served candidate, dated CSS and restored candidate. Pointer/focus state, rendered geometry, selected computed properties and decoded RGBA hashes are compared.

Animation/transition/caret painting is disabled consistently for settled captures. Ordered syntax preservation and normal integration checks retain motion scope; no animation-frame equivalence or exhaustive CSS/browser/viewport conformance claim is made.
Browser reports and captures have seven-day retention. Dated CSS inputs, hashes, comparison records and pinned runtime remain reproducible evidence.
Formatting increases source bytes; no measured performance improvement is claimed. Other intentional cascade overrides remain.
The target-switching audit item is a source-review reproduction lead, not a confirmed new defect or a fix in this release.

Production captures and HTTP checks are separate reads, not an atomic transaction or a guarantee against later edits. Private baselines remain ignored and only the sanitized verification report is uploaded.
No new physical-device, real credential/CAPTCHA or provider-write acceptance is claimed.
